name: issue-radar
description: Sidebar that lists the open GitHub issues of the current repository, each with a short AI recap and a link, and starts a dedicated Claude session for an issue with one click: summary, interview, proposal, then code.

openAtStart.title: Open at start
openAtStart.description: Open the Issues pane when a session starts in a folder that resolves to a GitHub repository.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the issue list is fetched while the pane is shown; 0 turns the timer off.

maxIssues.title: Issue cap
maxIssues.description: How many open issues are listed per repository, the most recently updated first.

recaps.title: AI recaps
recaps.description: Master switch for the AI recaps; each repository still needs a one-time consent in the pane.

recapModel.title: Recap model
recapModel.description: Model alias for the recaps: haiku (default) or sonnet.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane's labels and of the recaps: de or en.

closedDays.title: Recently closed (days)
closedDays.description: How many days back the collapsed Recently closed part of each repository reaches (0 to 90); 0 hides it. Fetched only while expanded and the pane is shown.

assignedToMe.title: Assigned to me (all repositories)
assignedToMe.description: Adds a collapsed section listing the open issues assigned to you in any repository, from GitHub search; fetched at most every 15 minutes while the pane is shown.
